name: Extended CLCIR PLIC Reconstruction
definition: A method to reconstruct a Piecewise Linear Interface Concept (PLIC) plane in Volume of Fluid (VOF) simulations on arbitrary polyhedral grids by extracting an isosurface from an interpolated scalar field and computing a weighted normal vector.
summary: Extended CLCIR PLIC Reconstruction determines interface orientation on arbitrary polyhedral grids by extracting isosurfaces and computing weighted normals, ensuring volume conservation in VOF simulations.
